current_stage.name: Shared DS2 shell convergence after factual-footer production repair
current_stage.last_material_progress: PR #792 repaired a confirmed site-wide DS2 regression introduced by the factual footer release: .ds2-site-footer markup was shared across search/home/editorial/country, but its approved visual layer remained search-only inside ds2-search.css, leaving non-search public routes without the canonical footer styling. The approved footer visual layer is now also owned by shared site-footer-v1.css; mobile editorial breadcrumbs were restored from 40px to the DS2 44px interaction rhythm. The standalone five-width workflow was hardened so changes to shared DS2 convergence/footer CSS trigger real 375/430/768/1024/1440 browser coverage and validate the canonical .ds2-site-footer styling plus five 44px social/app targets rather than stale legacy selectors. All 11 PR gates passed. Deploy V2 only and Deploy anytoour.ru completed successfully; V2 verification, public-page verification, unchanged lead-bridge validation and live-search smoke passed. Post-deploy migrated-content and five-width standalone-content live runs are green. Tourvisor, analytics/Metrika, lead transport, logo, verified destinations and unresolved legal/payment content were unchanged.
current_stage.next_action: Continue the shared country/editorial shell re-audit at 375/430/768/1024/1440, now focusing on confirmed CTA hierarchy/touch-target/wrapping inconsistencies and the country/editorial → /poisk-turov/ handoff. Re-check /, /hot/, /contacts/, /how-to-buy/, /rb/, /country/ and representative country pages against the now-canonical shared footer/breadcrumb behavior. Prefer shared-owner fixes only when a defect is confirmed; do not invent route-local styling or implement a new unapproved layout. Preserve the mature search/results/selected-tour path and loaded-results instant-local-filtering architecture.

local_results_filtering.rule: Result filters such as stars/rating/price/meal and other fields already present in normalized loaded results filter the loaded set instantly. A new Tourvisor search is reserved for real search-input changes or optional background capability expansion, not for every result-filter click.
